assertions.name: hopf_bond_wplane_annihilated
assertions.source: m_e·Vol(Hopf) = 0 identically — the W-plane (CAL-1×CAL-2) classes have zero support on the 2-body inter-nucleon bond channel (Hopf non-hyperbolic; ledger identification B = m_e·Vol)

assertions.name: cal3_unique_surviving_class
assertions.source: the 4-scale selection table re-read: m_pi is the unique scale whose required coefficient is within 25% of 1 AND the unique non-W-plane calibration class — the 2-bit selection collapses to class selection

assertions.name: coefficient_one_consistent
assertions.source: |1 − measured|/rms = 0.21σ < 1σ — coefficient 1 is consistent with the 8-pair systematics

assertions.name: coefficient_not_uniquely_selected
assertions.source: 8/9 simple Q(q0) candidates within 1.25σ of the measured coefficient — 'exactly 1' is NOT selected by the data at 7% scatter (honesty assertion; needs ~0.3% scatter to discriminate at 3σ)

assertions.name: two_body_energy_length_negative
assertions.source: hbar*c/B_D and hbar*c/mu0 are 60-90x lambda_pi — the packing length is not the inverse of a 2-body channel energy (scope-(a))

assertions.name: radius_energy_rescoping_identity
assertions.source: hbar*c/(lambda_pi*A^(1/3)) = m_pi*A^(-1/3) exactly — GAP 2 re-scopes to the A^(-1/3) energy exponent; no length object needed

assertions.name: borromean_per_cusp_volume_two
assertions.source: Borromean maximal-cusp volume per cusp = 2 exactly (area 4, SnapPy unbiased policy) — the candidate Euclidean packing unit

assertions.name: cusp_count_extensivity_fails_3h
assertions.source: 8_11 (the corpus 3H binding link) is a knot: 1 cusp for A=3 — cusp-per-nucleon extensivity fails on the corpus's own links

assertions.name: cusp_density_not_constant
assertions.source: maximal-cusp density spread x1.41 (0.604-0.853) across the corpus family — cusp volume is NOT more uniformly extensive than complement volume

assertions.name: cusp_facevalue_coefficients_miss
assertions.source: both pinned cusp normalizations miss the measured packing coefficient (coefficient-space metric, same as the Q(q0) table): per-cusp 2.0 at 2.9 sigma, whole-B3 6.0 at 2.0 sigma (1.4 in ratio-space) — no post-hoc selection made

description: R2-e attack on the two underived steps of the continuum-EM mirror split. GAP 1 (pion packing radius): the scale-CLASS is derived by W-plane annihilation — the inter-nucleon bond is a Vol=0 Hopf sub-link, so m_e·Vol vanishes identically and q0 is dimensionless; CAL-3 ('the Vol(Hopf)=0 meson scale') is the unique class with nonzero support, giving bond unit hbar*c/(m_pi*Q(q0)) — the 2-bit mass-scale selection collapses to 0 bits (conditional on B = m_e*Vol). The COEFFICIENT Q=1 stays underived: measured 0.985 ± 0.069, consistent at 0.21 sigma but with 8/9 simple Q(q0) within 1.25 sigma. GAP 2 (volume->radius): no functorial transport exists (taxonomy audit); re-scoped to the A^(-1/3) energy exponent. Cusp route: Euclidean tori genuine, but cusp-count extensivity fails at 3H (8_11 = knot), density spread x1.41, and both pinned normalizations miss at >=1.6 sigma. Scope-(a); exploratory; nothing wired.
